description: This file defines a struct named 'Tag' used in serialization logic for the Orleans framework. The 'Tag' struct encapsulates a byte value that encodes metadata about serialized fields, including wire type, schema type, and field identifiers, along with related methods and properties.

classes.name: Tag
classes.description: A struct representing a serialization tag byte, encapsulating wire type, schema type, and field id delta with methods to access and modify these properties.

methods.name: implicit operator Tag(byte)
methods.description: Converts a byte to a Tag struct.

methods.name: implicit operator byte(Tag)
methods.description: Converts a Tag struct to a byte.

methods.name: WireType get_WireType()
methods.description: Gets the wire type from the tag byte.

methods.name: void set_WireType(WireType)
methods.description: Sets the wire type in the tag byte.

methods.name: bool get_HasExtendedWireType()
methods.description: Determines if the tag has an extended wire type.

methods.name: ExtendedWireType get_ExtendedWireType()
methods.description: Gets the extended wire type if present.

methods.name: void set_ExtendedWireType(ExtendedWireType)
methods.description: Sets the extended wire type in the tag.

methods.name: bool get_IsEndBaseFields()
methods.description: Checks if the tag marks the end of base fields.

methods.name: bool get_IsEndObject()
methods.description: Checks if the tag marks the end of an object.

methods.name: SchemaType get_SchemaType()
methods.description: Retrieves the schema type from the tag.

methods.name: void set_SchemaType(SchemaType)
methods.description: Sets the schema type in the tag.

methods.name: bool get_IsSchemaTypeValid()
methods.description: Indicates whether the schema type is valid, i.e., not extended wire type.

methods.name: uint get_FieldIdDelta()
methods.description: Gets the field id delta from the tag.

methods.name: void set_FieldIdDelta(uint)
methods.description: Sets the field id delta in the tag.

methods.name: void SetFieldIdInvalid()
methods.description: Invalidates the field id delta, indicating a full field id must follow.

methods.name: bool get_IsFieldIdValid()
methods.description: Checks if the field id delta is valid or if a subsequent full field id is needed.

methods.name: bool get_HasExtendedFieldId()
methods.description: Checks if the tag indicates an extended field id follows.
